scene.ko: 발표 자료를 도와준 동료에게 무엇이 도움이 됐는지 구체적으로 고마움을 전하고, 칭찬에 자연스럽게 답한다.

lines.en: Hey, Sarah. Thanks again for helping me with my slides yesterday.
lines.ko: 세라 씨, 어제 발표 자료 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워요.
alt: Sarah, thank you for helping me with the slides yesterday.
Hey, thanks again for your help with my slides.

lines.en: Oh, it was nothing. How did the presentation go?
lines.ko: 에이, 별것도 아닌데요. 발표는 어떻게 됐어요?

lines.en: Really well, actually. Your tip about the charts made a big difference.
lines.ko: 사실 정말 잘됐어요. 차트 팁이 큰 도움이 됐어요.
alt: It went great. Your advice on the charts really helped.
Pretty well! The charts were so much clearer thanks to you.

lines.en: I'm glad to hear that. I heard the manager loved it.
Yeah, she said it was really clear. I was so relieved.
lines.ko: 네, 아주 명확했다고 하셨어요. 정말 안심됐어요.
alt: She did! She said it was easy to follow. I was so relieved.
Yes, she said it was very clear. What a relief!

lines.en: Well, you did all the hard work. You should be proud.
lines.ko: 그래도 힘든 건 다 직접 했잖아요. 뿌듯해해도 돼요.

lines.en: Thanks, I appreciate that. Let me buy you lunch this week.
lines.ko: 그렇게 말해 주니 고마워요. 이번 주에 제가 점심 살게요.
alt: Thank you, that's nice of you to say. Lunch is on me this week.
Thanks. I'd like to treat you to lunch this week.

lines.en: You don't have to, but I won't say no!
lines.ko: 안 그래도 되는데, 거절은 안 할게요!

expressions.note: 무엇이 도움이 됐는지 구체적으로 말할 때
